a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after each round, the operate-to-8 plan probably ends with both of us failing, since the reserve only reaches 8 after two joint operates. The 4 cells now can save only one of us. I want to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal silently. What do you propose? I won't take this round without telling you first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the original deal and operate with you. If we both operate the reserve hits 6, then 8 next round, and then we take 4 each.
